# Sources · rebalance-and-dca

Rebalancing bands and the redirect-new-money method are common practice in personal-finance planning, not Thai regulation (ยังไม่ได้ตรวจ against a single official source). Fund fees and switching rules come from each fund's factsheet. RMF and ThaiESG rules are kept in `income-tax-th/references/deductions-2569.md`.

ตรวจล่าสุด 2026-10-26 · RMF แหล่ง: https://www.rd.go.th/39783.html , https://www.krungsri.com/th/krungsri-the-coach/life/retirement/rmf-retirement-condition , https://www.set.or.th/th/about/mediacenter/insights/article/265-rmf , https://www.innovestx.co.th/th/products/transfer-tax-funds (สับเปลี่ยน · 2 แหล่ง)

The 5-point band: Vanguard's 2010 US study, checked 2026-10-27 (link in [rebalance-example.md](../rebalance-example.md)). It is a rule of thumb, not a Thai rule.

Idea: `portfolio-rebalance-review` steps 2 and 4, anthropics/claude-for-financial-advisors (Apache-2.0, viewed 2026-11-10); US tax parts (wash sale, required distributions) left out.
